app_fee.value: International applicants pay a nonrefundable $70 USD application fee ($50 for U.S. citizens).
app_fee.quote: A $50, nonrefundable, application fee. (For international applicants, the nonrefundable application fee is $70, paid in U.S. currency.)

also.quote: non-refundable $50 for U.S. citizen; $70 for International Students

fee_waiver.value: Graduate application fee waiver eligibility criteria are not published on graduate admissions pages (the application process page notes only that applicants who qualify for a waiver should select Check or Money Order on ApplyTexas).

gre_general.value: GRE General requirements are set by individual degree programs (not required/waived for Computer Science Ph.D. and Coastal and Marine System Science Ph.D. program page, omitted from Engineering Ph.D. materials, and listed as required in the 2026-2027 catalog for Marine Biology Ph.D.).

toefl_min.value: University minimum is 4 on the TOEFL iBT scale effective after January 21, 2026 (73 iBT prior to January 21, 2026; 537 paper-based). Coastal and Marine System Science Ph.D. sets a higher minimum (79-80 iBT / 550 PBT); see program override.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL IBT score of 73, or if taken after January 21, 2026 a minimum score of 4

also.quote: If you take the TOEFL iBT on or after January 21, 2026

ielts_min.value: University minimum is IELTS Academic 6.0 overall band (IELTS General is not accepted). Coastal and Marine System Science Ph.D. requires 6.5; see program override.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum IELTS Academic test score of 6.0 overall band for both undergraduate and graduate students

english_waiver.value: India is not among the exempt English-official countries listed in the Graduate Catalog, and degree-based exemption requires a bachelor's degree or two years of instruction at a U.S. or Canadian institution.
english_waiver.quote: The applicant completed a bachelor’s degree at a U.S. or Canadian institution of higher education, or | In addition, applicant's native to one of the following countries whose official language is English will be exempt from the TOEFL or IELTS requirements:

notes: Public R2 university in Corpus Christi, Texas (Texas A&M University System). Offers 4 STEM Ph.D. programs represented by 6 Atlas records: Computer Science (CS), Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical; the Industrial and Process Engineering concentration has no matching Atlas field), Marine Biology (Biology), and Coastal and Marine System Science (Environment, also Earth). Under Texas Education Code Section 54.212, non-resident/international students holding a 50% FTE graduate assistantship qualify for in-state tuition and fees.
